items.title: Some testiness here in OKC; Dillon Brooks put a hard forearm into Thunder rookie Aday Mara as he came up the floor in transition. Thunder vet Kenrich Williams took exception to it and the two exchanged shoves. Foul has been upgraded to a flagrant-1, and Brooks also got a tech.
